company.name: Aquarium
company.shortDescription: Aquarium is expertise in making machine learning accessible to its customers that helps to simplify their models by improving datasets.
company.description:
Aquarium Learning is an ML data management platform that helps to improve models by improving datasets.

The company was founded in 202 and based in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that helps identify and fix data quality issues by visualizing data and labels, finding errors, and collaborating on dataset problems.
productsAndServices.name: Data Quality Analysis

productsAndServices.description: A service to analyze model performance by comparing model inferences with human labels, diagnosing failures, and tracking improvements over time.
productsAndServices.name: Model Evaluation

productsAndServices.description: A system to efficiently collect and sample data by searching large unlabeled datasets to find and label the most useful examples for model improvement.
productsAndServices.name: Data Collection & Sampling

productsAndServices.description: A set of APIs and webhooks that connect Aquarium with existing ML pipelines and labeling systems to automate data workflows and enable seamless collaboration.
